Credit: magele-picture - stock.adobe.com WAUSAU – Prevail Bank once again invites community members to make a difference during the holiday season through its annual Holiday Matching Funds Campaign, which runs from Nov. 16 through Dec. 4. During the three-week fundraising effort, donations collected at participating Prevail Bank locations will benefit local nonprofit organizations selected by each branch. At the conclusion of the campaign, Prevail Bank will match public donations dollar-for-dollar, up to $1,000 per community. “Supporting our communities has always been an important part of who we are,” said Nathan Quinnell, CEO/president of Prevail Bank. “The Holiday Matching Funds Campaign allows us to partner with our customers, employees, and neighbors to make an even greater impact for local organizations that provide assistance, hope, and resources to individuals and families in need.” The following nonprofit organizations will benefit from this year’s campaign (listed by branch location):
 Wausau: The Salvation Army’s Angel Tree – Make a donation or take a tag from the tree in Prevail Bank’s lobby.
 Baraboo: Sauk County Children’s Giving Tree 
 Eau Claire: Eau Claire County Children’s Giving Tree 
 Marshfield: Ronald McDonald House of Marshfield 
 Medford: Taylor County Humane Society 
 Owen: W-O-W Kids Meals, a weekend meal program for children experiencing food insecurity. Bonus impact: The Owen-Withee Lions Club will also match the public donations collected at Prevail Bank-Owen up to $1,000.
 Phillips: Catkins Animal Rescue 
 Stevens Point: Operation Bootstrap , an organization that assists families in crisis
 Wisconsin Rapids: South Wood County Humane Society 
 Community members are encouraged to contribute at any Prevail Bank branch participating in the campaign. Donations of all sizes are welcomed, and every dollar contributed will help support local programs and services during the holiday season. Help Us Keep Local Journalism Alive
